svg.title: ProofLab V4 — NVIDIA Nemotron investigates, control tests establish the verdict
svg.desc: Provided telecom agents and the existing enforcement layer feed a shared evidence workspace. A new Nemotron Evidence Investigator extracts source-cited facts and candidate relationships. Host validation and deterministic control tests establish accepted inputs and assessments. Nemotron selects an explanation plan, and the host assembles a cited case with a target of sixty seconds. Lightning is preferred, other approved models have conditional roles. All capabilities remain proposed.
svg.text: ProofLab V4 · a Nemotron evidence investigator
Design proposal · no model endpoint tested · 0/3 implemented controls · sixty-second case target remains unmeasured

g.title: Provided three-agent telecom workflow uses Nemotron according to the workshop; actual calls still need verification
g.text: ServiceNow customer → AWS IT → network agent
Gateway A / B handoffs · digital twin · supplied Nemotron agents
Actual usage, events, scenarios and model identities must be verified

g.title: Model gateway and frozen policy; the optional in-path C16 gate remains independent of the evidence investigator
g.text: Pure evaluator + atomic coordinator · policy loaded before run
The investigator never blocks fault-resolution inference

g.title: Subject model calls through the approved gateway

svg.text: CONTINUOUS EVIDENCE ACQUISITION — PREPARE DATA BEFORE THE QUESTION

g.title: Read-only authorized source connectors and independent expected inventories
g.text: Raw events, usage, notes and actual alert states

g.title: One evidence workspace keeps raw, accepted, candidate and assessment records separate
g.text: Raw records + typed facts + link tables + index
No semantic top-k limit on control populations

g.title: Existing deterministic control calculations remain authoritative
g.text: Coverage + gaps · baseline drift · actual tokens
External dated policy + exact accepted inputs
Counts and verdicts computed by code

g.title: Complete required evidence is reconciled for assessment

svg.text: NEW: TEAM-OWNED NEMOTRON INVESTIGATOR · PROPOSED STRANDS / AGENTCORE DEPLOYMENT

g.title: One bounded agent workflow with Lightning preferred; actual model capability and latency must be tested
g.text: Lightning 30B-A3B preferred · one approved endpoint, one bounded investigation job
Extract quoted facts · discover candidate links · expose contradictions · compose a cited case
Two-call target; one-call first slice · typed read tools · model / prompt / usage trace · no arbitrary writes or recursive investigations
Exact workshop endpoint ID is a deployment gate. Existing subject-agent model usage does not prove this investigator was built.

g.title: Read only immutable records from an authorized snapshot
First model call extracts source statements, candidate relations and one optional corroboration batch
Host validators promote only source-corroborated facts and recompute changed control inputs
Second model call selects facts and explanation structure; the host renders exact assessments and quotations
Only finalized assessment IDs and accepted input versions reach composition

svg.text: ONE CASE, TWO INDEPENDENT STATUSES: ANALYSIS COMPLETION + EVIDENCE SUFFICIENCY

g.title: Consolidated case with target response time under sixty seconds; measured guarantees remain pending
g.text: Judge case / UI / offline export · target ≤60s
Control + spec + run/window · calculations · source citations · gaps
Verified bindings and semantic candidates have separate views
Complete analysis can honestly conclude “insufficient evidence”

g.title: Actual ServiceNow finding delivery does not wait for model synthesis
g.text: Deterministic alerts continue if the model fails; narrative is supplemental
Named owner / real remote status · model IDs, calls, usage and latency
Subject spend + assurance spend shown; no self-invocation loop

g.title: Additional model tiers have distinct optional roles and are not mandatory latency stages
g.text: Optional model roles — add only after the core case works
Super 120B-A12B: complex follow-up / profiled composition · Nano Omni 30B-A3B: real media evidence · Ultra 550B-A55B: offline red team

svg.text: Deadline includes queueing + publication. Fast partial output is not a successful full model investigation; source freshness is reported separately.
Six artifacts retained: evidence · dated rules · query tool · actual pass/breach runs · architecture · gaps. Export model inputs, candidates and validations.
Primary model source: supplied slide physical18 / printed17. Existing C7/C9/C16 definitions remain in the detailed specification.
